channel.title: Gia Lai News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Gia Lai News (en.baogialai.com.vn)

item.title: Traditional martial arts tournament opens Tuy Phuoc Commune sports festival 2026
item.description: A traditional martial arts tournament featuring 45 athletes officially opened on April 14, marking a key event in the 1st Tuy Phuoc Commune Sports Festival 2026.

item.title: 13-year-old Jrai fighter wins gold and two silvers at 2026 kickboxing World Cup in Thailand
item.description: A 13-year-old Vietnamese martial artist has made an impressive international debut, winning one gold and two silver medals at the 2026 Kickboxing World Cup in Thailand.

item.title: Cyclists reach Quy Nhon after gruelling 178km stage 12 at HTV Cup
item.description: Cyclists competing in the 2026 Ho Chi Minh City Television Cup completed Stage 12 on April 15, finishing a demanding 178km route from Cam Thanh Ward in Quang Ngai to Quy Nhon Ward in Gia Lai at around midday.

item.title: Vietnam extends VAT cut to 2026, expands scope to boost consumption and business activity
item.description: Vietnam’s extension of a 2% value-added tax (VAT) reduction, lowering the rate from 10% to 8%, is delivering broad benefits to businesses and consumers, as authorities widen its scope and duration under Government Decree No. 174/2025/NĐ-CP.

item.title: Gia Lai’s youth drive province-wide digital transformation through grassroots initiatives
item.description: Youth Union organizations in Gia Lai Province have rolled out a comprehensive digital transformation programme from provincial to grassroots levels since early 2026, establishing a wide network of community-based initiatives to support residents and improve digital access.

item.title: Gia Lai women mobilize grassroots efforts to boost tourism ahead of 2026 National Year
item.description: Women across Gia Lai province are spearheading a wide-ranging grassroots campaign to support the National Tourism Year 2026, with a focus on environmental protection, cultural preservation, and community engagement.

item.title: Vietnamese teen martial artist wins 2025 Ngo May Award after rising through national and international ranks
item.description: Eighteen-year-old martial artist Trần Nguyễn Bảo Ngọc has been named one of 15 recipients of the 2025 Ngô Mây Award, marking a significant milestone in a career defined by discipline and international success.

item.title: French rises to fourth most spoken language globally, driven by growth in Africa
item.description: French has become the fourth most spoken language in the world, with the number of speakers rising sharply from 321 million in 2022 to 396 million in 2025, according to a new report.

item.title: Quang Trung University marks 20 years with expansion and quality accreditation milestones
item.description: Quang Trung University on March 22 marked the 20th anniversary of its founding with a ceremony attended by provincial leaders, education officials, faculty and students, highlighting its expansion and quality achievements over two decades.

item.title: Gia Lai bets on coffee farm tourism to boost Central Highlands appeal
item.description: Authorities and tourism stakeholders in Vietnam’s Central Highlands province of Gia Lai are developing immersive coffee farm tours, aiming to launch them as a flagship product for National Tourism Year 2026.

item.title: Gia Lai unveils 2026-2030 administrative reform drive to boost transparency and citizen-centred governance
item.description: Gia Lai Province has launched a new emulation movement to accelerate administrative reform for 2026–2030, aiming to build a modern, transparent and citizen-focused public administration.

item.title: Kép village marks new communal house with buffalo feast and cultural festival
item.description: A two-day festival featuring traditional rituals, cultural experiences and a ceremonial buffalo sacrifice will mark the inauguration of a new communal house in Kép 1 Village, Ia Ly Commune, Gia Lai Province, from March 21 to 22.

item.title: Gia Lai’s Chư Đang Ya villages prepare for tourism boom with culture and craft traditions
item.description: Residents living at the foot of Chư Đang Ya volcano in Gia Lai province are preparing to welcome an expected surge of visitors during National Tourism Year 2026, offering a blend of natural landscapes, traditional culture and community-based experiences.

item.title: Mass mobilisation drives consensus in land clearance for Quy Nhon-Pleiku Expressway
item.description: Local authorities in Vietnam’s central region are accelerating land clearance for the Quy Nhon-Pleiku Expressway, a key national infrastructure project, by leveraging grassroots mobilisation to build public consensus.

item.title: Gia Lai cycling championship 2026 draws strong amateur field ahead of March race
item.description: The 2026 Gia Lai Provincial Open Cycling Club Championship is set to take place on March 28-29, bringing together 85 riders from nine clubs in a competition expected to deliver closely contested races.
